svg.title: Known phase-fold shifts, pi/16 endpoint energies, and a zero-phase M2 minimum corrected to a saddle at load 76 but not 80.
svg.desc: English: Known phase-fold shifts, pi/16 endpoint energies, and a zero-phase M2 minimum corrected to a saddle at load 76 but not 80. 繁體中文：已知相位 fold 位移、pi/16 端點能量，以及零相位 M2 極小值在負載 76 校正成鞍點、80 則保留極小值。

cc:Work.dc:description: Local higher-mode diagnostics using Gauss-128, with no new solves performed for plotting. Panel (a) uses the separately saved PAL-turn analysis of ZIP M=2 folds at phases pi/32 and pi/16, correcting the known events into M=4, 6, 8, 12. Verified corrections outside the original window are retained; the dotted line marks its upper load 90. Panel (b) uses the pi/16-phase source at load 90: the lowest-known seed is corrected only at the stored truncations, while the fold-local minimum is displayed only where its recorded diagnostic actually reaches 90. Unmeasured M4 source-seed correction is a gap. A refined fold outside the window leaves its endpoint unattempted, not zero. Panel (c) uses different, zero-phase controls: at each predeclared load 76 and 80 it selects the higher-energy strict M2 source minimum with positive q1 and plots its saved Morse classification. At 76, index 0 becomes index 1 at M6, 8, 12; at 80 all stored corrections remain index 0. Black crosses identify accepted non-minima. No M4 correction was stored for these two source-seed series, so that slot remains a gap; connecting other stored mode counts is not locating an intervening stability boundary. All failed, unresolved and reclassified records remain in the inputs. These local source-seed corrections neither prove global family identity nor enumerate complete high-mode landscapes or establish physical validity.
